Full job description
Baer is looking for Senior EDI Developer Consultant for a 1+ month remote project

Title: Senior EDI Developer Consultant
Location: Remote (Must be based in US)
Duration: 1 months + Extension
Rate: All-inclusive
Alignment: W2 or C2C

Overview

We are seeking a Senior EDI Developer Consultant with strong technical and functional expertise in EDI integrations, SAP S/4HANA, and middleware platforms. The consultant will design, develop, support, and optimize end-to-end EDI solutions while working closely with business teams, SAP teams, and external trading partners.

Description:
Lead end-to-end EDI solution design, development, and implementation aligned with business requirements and SAP best practices.
Develop and support EDI integrations between SAP S/4HANA, middleware, and third-party systems.
Work with ANSI X12, EDIFACT, IDoc, XML, and other EDI formats, including mapping, transformation, and validation.
Manage trading partner onboarding, connectivity, testing, certification, and production readiness.
Support middleware platforms such as SAP Integration Suite/CPI, SAP PI/PO, and EDI translators.
Monitor EDI transactions, troubleshoot integration failures, and resolve defects and production incidents.
Implement monitoring, alerting, reconciliation, and error-handling processes to ensure reliable data exchange.
Collaborate with functional teams across OTC, P2P, Logistics, and Finance to validate business processes and EDI scenarios.
Create and maintain interface mappings, technical documentation, process flows, and support procedures.
Support SIT, UAT, cutover, and go-live activities, including defect resolution and production support.
Ensure EDI solutions meet security, audit, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
Partner with business stakeholders, SAP teams, vendors, and trading partners to drive issue resolution and continuous improvement.

Requirements:
Strong experience in EDI development and integration.
Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA, IDocs, and EDI interfaces.
Experience with ANSI X12, EDIFACT, XML, mapping, and transformation.
Strong knowledge of SAP Integration Suite/CPI, PI/PO, or EDI translators.
Experience with trading partner onboarding, testing, and certification.
Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Experience supporting SIT, UAT, cutover, and production environments.

Company Overview:

Baer provides best-in-class engagement experiences for our consultants. Our job requirements are carefully vetted and are typically associated with pivotal programs offering tremendous opportunities to expand your skills leveraging the latest solutions.

Baer is an equal opportunity employer including disability/veteran.
